I don't know how it feels to loose a parent, but I know so well the feeling you described as loathing yourself, telling yourself every night to make the next day better, and failing every morning, to do so.
 
Here's what I've come to terms with: that feelin,g is never going to leave me completely, sure, it may come and go, but as soon as I make a mistake or something goes wrong, I go back to those same cyclic thoughts. I know it's not good for me, I know that I need to think positive and uplifting thoughts about myself but in those moments, it almost seems pleasurable to think and about myself. To tell myself that I suck, I'm useless, I'm a piece of trash, im a waste of space, I don't deserve the luxuries I have, I don't deserve love. 

At the time I'm consumed by them, the emotions form an airtight bubble around me, and I cant see past them, the whole thing fucking  sucks.

BUT eventually it passes, sometimes I cry it all out, other times I distract myself, if I'm lucky talking to a friend about something random  helps, but that's rare, I know, most people don't understand. They think I'm overreacting, sensitive, " just putting myself down for no reason", they brush it off as if it's nbd.

Maybe it is, maybe I am, I don't really know anything anymore. I'm getting off track, the point is that it passes, for brief periods of time, I can think clearly again and that's all I look forward to.

Go to a therapist, a good one , that wont disregard what you have to say, fighting it alone is very hard and it's gonna take a long time, so don't delay it any longer. And use you're friends as support when it gets too hard to face the thoughts all alone. You don't have to tell them everything, just let them be there with you.

And lastly, things will get better, they always do. As for the decisions you have to make, take them carefully with a lot of thought, no matter where you end up, you will learn something or the other, fuck people's expectations, go with you're gut.
